findings.summary: A later reasoning item overwrites the pending lifecycle's index and signature.
findings.failure_scenario: Reasoning index 2 starts, emits summary text, and becomes stop-pending; reasoning item index 7 is then added before the next summary event. r02 overwrites the global thinking index/signature, so the index-2 block emits signature sig_7 and stops at index 7 instead of finalizing entirely at index 2 with sig_2.
findings.required_change: Finalize or retain each active reasoning lifecycle before selecting a different reasoning item, and ignore stale completion events that do not belong to the active item.

findings.summary: Function and text blocks can overlap and consecutive functions share unsafe global state.
findings.failure_scenario: A function block at index 9 followed by text at index 5 starts the text block without stopping the function; a delayed function done then stops index 9 after text closes. Starting a second function before the first completes also reuses one global index and emits duplicate or misindexed stops.
findings.required_change: Track function blocks by stable event identity, stop the active function before text, thinking, completion, or a different function starts, and make delayed done events for already-closed functions no-ops.

resolution: Do not apply r02. Mint a corrected immutable revision with direct regressions for all three reproduced lifecycle failures and repeat independent review.
